cost_basis.cheapest_design: Use recorded commands and deterministic replay without model calls for structural checks. Authoring creates checkable artifacts in the existing harness; actors and interpretation retain their current single-call boundaries. A new comparison needs a named decision that argument and retained evidence cannot settle. Fixture costs establish neither semantic-review benefit nor future workload cost. I0/I1 reuses the existing semantic review call for actual initial actor contexts; no additional cognition or review stage is introduced. Free paired-input, authority and replay checks precede the minimum real generated/resident demonstration.

plain_baseline.answer_path: Attempt interpretation: one model call receives the complete actor-authorized utterance, installed signatures and known entities; deterministic typed/quote checks follow. This current implementation is already the plain version.
plain_baseline.when: Only if a future proposal adds an AI stage to interpretation and a named decision survives argument. No comparison run is needed or authorized by this documentation repair.
